title: On Folding the linen in half
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：fold　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fold 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the foreman ① folded the linen in half in public, and every worker in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the foreman ② folds the linen in half in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ fold the linen in half at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ folded the linen in half before — a line in the sheet for May 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Folding the linen in half in public, the foreman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ fold the sheep into the lower field in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Fold the sheep into the lower field at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the sheet, and a new worker from the next site ⑧ folds the sheep into the lower field in public every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ramp, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ folded the linen in half again when nobody else would.

⑩ To fold the linen in half, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody folds the linen in half in silence again and somebody must fold the linen in half in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 折叠（一般过去式 folded the linen in half：1957 年工头头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 折叠（一般现在 folds the linen in half：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 折叠（不定式 to fold the linen in half：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 折叠（过去完成时 had folded the linen in half：1951 年五月的施工单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 折叠（动名词 folding the linen in half 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 收拢（fold the sheep into the lower field：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去收拢把羊收进下面那块地）
G. v. 收拢（fold the sheep into the lower field：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 折叠（后段两处：新来的工人照例 folds the sheep into the lower field，而母亲又一次 folded the linen in half）

answers.why: fold 意为“折叠”，1957 年工头当着众人面折叠把亚麻布对折，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 folded。
fold 意为“折叠”，自那以后工头一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 folds。
fold 意为“折叠”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯折叠把亚麻布对折”，此处为不定式 to fold the linen in half。
fold 意为“折叠”，施工单里 五月 那行字说明早在 1964 年之前就有人折叠过，故用过去完成时 had folded。
fold 意为“折叠”，工头说“折叠把亚麻布对折这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 folding the linen in half 作主语。
fold 意为“收拢”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去收拢把羊收进下面那块地”，should ever 之后用原形 fold the sheep into the lower field。
fold 意为“收拢”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻收拢把羊收进下面那块地（fold the sheep into the lower field at once），以后再也不要提起。
fold 意为“折叠”，新来的工人每个班次都照例收拢把羊收进下面那块地，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 folds。
fold 意为“折叠”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面折叠把亚麻布对折，用一般过去式 folded 叙述。
fold 意为“折叠”，结尾那句是母亲 1969 年的话：要折叠把亚麻布对折，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 fold 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the foreman folded the linen in half in public, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the foreman folds the linen in half in silence whenever the site asks.
Folding the linen in half in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever fold the sheep into the lower field in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next site folds the sheep into the lower field in public every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother folded the linen in half again, and the site remembered that half.
